title: CDN in 60 seconds
caption: CDNs in 60 seconds: why a website loads fast on the other side of the world from its server.

scenes.say: Your server is in Virginia. A visitor in Johannesburg waits for every byte to cross an ocean and back.
A CDN puts copies near everyone.

items.title: Edge
items.say: It runs servers in cities all over the world.

items.title: Cache
items.text: keep a copy of your files
items.say: They keep copies of your files.

items.title: Nearby
items.say: Each visitor is served from the closest one.

scenes.code:
visitor in Johannesburg
  → edge in Johannesburg: HIT

first visitor ever
  → edge: MISS → origin → cached
scenes.say: Only the first request goes all the way to your server. After that, it's local.
That's a CDN. Move the content closer to people.
